value.name: Dicky returns to the gym
value.description: Dicky comes back into the gym just as Micky is about to train with O'Keefe.
evidence: Dicky walks back into the gym as Micky is about to work out with O'Keefe.

value.name: Dicky says he was cut from training
value.description: Dicky tells Alice that Micky said he cannot work with him anymore.
evidence: ALICE What happened?
DICKY He says I can't work with him.

value.name: Dicky claims credit for Sanchez victory
value.description: Dicky angrily insists that Micky would never have beaten Sanchez without his help.
evidence: He never woulda won Sanchez without me!

value.name: O'Keefe demands respect for his mother
value.description: O'Keefe objects when Dicky insults Alice and tells him to take it back.
evidence: MICKEY O'KEEFE That's fuckin' bullshit! Take that back!
DICKY Don't talk to my mother my mother like that.

value.name: Group pressures Micky to choose
value.description: Alice and Charlene push Micky to answer whether he needed Dicky to win Sanchez, putting him on the spot.
evidence: ALICE Why don't you ask Micky?
CHARLENE They have to go, Micky.
ALICE Why don't you ask Micky if he woulda won Sanchez without Dicky? Ask him.
They all look at Micky. He is torn up over this as he considers it before he speaks and they all watch, tense.

value.name: Micky credits Dicky for Sanchez win
value.description: Micky admits he would not have beaten Sanchez without Dicky and explains he changed tactics based on Dicky's training.
evidence: MICKY I wouldn'ta won Sanchez without Dicky.
I went in with our plan and it wasn't working, I switched to what I learned with Dicky.

value.name: Micky reassures O'Keefe
value.description: Micky tells O'Keefe he also would not have won without him, trying to soften the blow.
evidence: MICKY (CONT'D) I wouldn'ta won it without you, either, O'Keefe, you know that.

value.name: Charlene and Alice defend their own roles
value.description: Charlene and Alice argue that Micky's success came from them and that Dicky merely saved him.
evidence: CHARLENE You got the focus and confidence from O'Keefe and Sal and your father and me!
ALICE You were lucky to win that fight, Dicky saved him!
CHARLENE We saved him!

value.name: Dicky reveals sobriety
value.description: Dicky responds to the insults by saying he has been sober for eight months.
evidence: DICKY Fuck you, Charlene, I'm 8 months sober.

value.name: Dicky argues for equal inclusion
value.description: Dicky says O'Keefe is allowed to be there despite his own problems and asks why he is excluded because he is family.
evidence: DICKY O'Keefe's in the same boat I am, one day at a time, why's it all right for him to be here, but not me? I'm blood.

value.name: Micky asserts control over training
value.description: Micky insists that he is the fighter and that he alone knows what he needs.
evidence: MICKY I'm the one fighting, not you, not you, and not YOU. I know what I need.

value.name: Micky chooses Dicky and family
value.description: After wavering, Micky declares that he wants Dicky back along with Charlene, O'Keefe, and his family.
evidence: Micky roils as he makes this decision.
MICKY I want Dicky back. And I want you, Charlene, and I want O'Keefe, and my family.
